name: Overnight GPU
hook: Ship 300 server racks overnight for fifty bucks before the postal van snaps
tagline: A groaning mail courier attempts to stack a 60-million-dollar AI supercluster into an ordinary delivery hatchback. As the multiplier spikes, miles of glowing fiber-optic cables drag behind and the suspension screams under 9,000 molten server cards. Cash out to sign the delivery clipboard and scurry away, or crash when the fragile parcel explodes into smoking silicon confetti.
